corrections.corrected_statement: At a steady red light, a right turn may be made after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians with the right of way, unless signs prohibit the turn.
A left turn from a one-way street onto another one-way street may be made on steady red after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians, unless posted otherwise.
When starting from the curb or changing lanes always check your mirrors first and signal for five seconds or one hundred feet before moving your vehicle.
corrections.note: Added the required five seconds or one hundred feet signal timing.

corrections.corrected_statement: Food in the stomach slows the described absorption compared with an empty stomach; it does not establish safe driving after drinking.
